podcast.title: Arranger for "Mess Around"
podcast.body: Jesse Stone was responsible for creating the arrangement for Ray Charles's song "Mess Around," a track that fused traditional elements with a new Atlantic House style. "Jesse Stone came up with an arrangement, and the result was titled Messeround."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 32: "I Got A Woman" by Ray Charles

podcast.title: Influence on Louis Jordan's Band Formation
podcast.body: Jesse Stone, previously mentioned as the writer of "Shake, Rattle and Roll," saw members of his band recruited by Louis Jordan to form the Tympany Five. "made up of members of Jesse Stone's band. You'll remember Jesse Stone from episode two, he wrote Shake, Wattland, Roll."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 4: "Choo Choo Ch'Boogie" by Louis Jordan

podcast.title: Talent Scout Role
podcast.body: Jesse Stone's activities for Atlantic Records are mentioned in comparison to Richie Barrett's role as a talent scout and producer for George Goldner, highlighting a common function in the music industry of finding and developing artists. "or that Jesse Stone did for Atlantic."
